As fate would have it, they fall in love with the same man, Jia-ming. Because of their different values and lifestyles, they are destined to arrive at two completely different endings..

programme.title: 沒有美色殺人狂
programme.desc: 'Do we lacking anything? We have a house, a truck, and very attractive.' Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-pil and sexy guy Sang-gu leave an unforgettable first impression on their moving day. Despite becoming special surveillance targets for Police Chief Choi and Officer Nam, they are simply happy to start anew in their European-style dream house. However, happiness is short-lived as they are inadvertently mistaken for kidnappers while trying to rescue Mina, who almost drowns. Meanwhile, uninvited guests looking for Mina start appearing, and an ancient spirit sealed in the basement awakens, surrounding the house with dark energy.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：鄭秀文: 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taiwan and one in China. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taiwan sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from China is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: 過時．過節
programme.desc: The chaos began at the Winter Solstice dinner eight years ago. The father lost his temper, the son, not able to forgive his father, ran away from home. Eight years have passed, and the family's relationship is still cold and distant. A cousin returns to Hong Kong from England and hopes to gather everyone for a Winter Solstice dinner. The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. When things are about to fall apart, it might as well be an opportunity to mend connections.

programme.title: 愛情扯大纜
programme.desc: A story of the sad love between a man who dedicates his youth to the nearly 420-year-old tradition of the Sendai Grand Tug-of-War, and a Korean medical resident who works on Koshiki island, and what happens with them and their families.

programme.title: 孤男寡女
programme.desc: Kinki is transferred to Andy's division due to 'office politics'. Rumors have it that Andy is womanizer and Kinki is unwilling to work with him! However, life is mysterious..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 才貌「謙」備: 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w.

programme.title: 屍蹤
programme.desc: Entering the houses with the key entrusted to him by the clients, 'Koo Jung-tae', a real estate agent with a hobby of spying on other people's lives. He becomes intrigued by SNS influencer 'Han Sora'. She posts a photo of a vegan salad while actually eating convenience store sausage, prompting him to begin spying on her closely. ‘Koo Jung-tae', eventually sneaks into ‘Han Sora's house, discovers her lifeless body on the sofa. Soon after, he starts receiving threats from someone who knows he was there. As homicide detective 'Oh Young-joo's investigation closes in on him, ‘Koo Jung-tae' is compelled to search for the real culprit using clues from 'Han Sora's social media and the people around her.

programme.title: 黑社會
programme.desc: The time has come, as it does every two years, for the senior members of Hong Kong's oldest Triad, The Wo Shing Society, to elect a new chairman. Fierce rivalries emerge between the two eligible candidates. Lok, respected by the Uncles is the favorite to win. But his rival Big D will stop at nothing to change this, including going against hundreds of years of Triad tradition and influencing the vote with money and violence.

programme.title: 黑社會2以和為貴
programme.desc: In post-1997 Hong Kong, even the long-established “Wo Shing” Triad Society has to succumb to the power of China. The entrepreneurial sect leader Jimmy (Louis Koo) seems to be the perfect candidate to lead the Society into the new Millennium. Only problem is, Jimmy wants out..

programme.title: 《一秒鐘》幕後紀錄片
programme.desc: “One Second” is the beautiful, moving and deeply personal homage to the redemptive power of cinema from Director Zhang Yimou. This documentary shows the behind-the-scene all the way from pre-production until the last shooting day of the film.

programme.title: 一秒鐘
programme.desc: China during the Cultural Revolution. A prisoner escapes from a labour camp. He risks everything in his search for a stolen film reel in which his long-lost daughter appears – for one second. Soon he encounters the thief, an orphaned girl haunted by her own terrible loss.

programme.title: 異山怪談
programme.desc: Members of 'GO2MOUNTAIN' bike riding club try valleys of Mount CHIAK where unreal too-cleanly-cut mutilation murders happened. Moments of freedom riding the mountain, odd things happen around them. Will they survive through what that haunts.

programme.title: 原諒他77次
programme.desc: When Adam and Eva break up after ten years, Adam thinks the breach was caused by one trivial incident, but Eva knows she's already forgiven Adam 77 times! Sweethearts since law school, Adam changed professions to start a Thai boxing studio and gradually became indifferent to Eva. Seemingly petty matters, like forgetting she hates raisin cookies, become the catalyst for her moving out and changing her Facebook status to 'single'. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' Reading it makes Adam realize his love. But what can he do to win her back? And what secret is contained in the journal's torn-out last page? He rushes to Eva and melts her heart by recounting their happy memories. When Eva tells him Heartbreak #77.

programme.title: 孩子轉運站
programme.desc: 'Sanghyeon' is always struggling from debt, and 'Dongsu' works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: 猶瑟與虎魚們
programme.desc: A fateful encounter between average college student Tsuneo and a wheelchair-bound dreamer, Josee, who spends her time reading and painting. As Tsuneo is swept up by her dreams, Josee takes another chance at facing reality.

programme.title: 女人街，再見了
programme.desc: A 11-year-old illegal immigrant, Tung, stays and lives in the Ladies' Market with T-shirt seller, Fai. One day, Tung rescued Yan who is kidnapped. Two of them bumped into van driver Pui Yi and gangster Ho..

programme.title: 愛在安娜普納峰
programme.desc: On a sunny spring day, Kang Hyun goes hiking in Bugaksan Mountain with Sun Woo who has been recently discharged from the military. It is already past noon but they continue a casual conversation about their past relationships while hiking along trails. Kang Hyun reminisces about the bittersweet memories of his exes ‘Anna' and ‘Eun Chae', while Sun Woo regrets treating his ex ‘Eun Jung' badly and blames his immaturity in the past relationship with ‘Pureum'.Kang Hyun and Sun Woo come across different people along the trail. They pass by a good-looking woman in tight leggings who instantly capture their eyes. They also come across a middle-aged man who gives disappointing hiking tips, which make them feel hopeless. ‘Anna' and ‘Pureum' incarnate our bygone lovers who we once strongly admired but failed to reach.Though hiking is as tough as life can be, it can also bring you joy because some people come into our lives and make us happy. Though Annapurna is one of the toughest moun.

programme.title: 72家租客
programme.desc: Past and present survival of the common man in the big city - ups and downs, laughters and tears... In 1970s Hong Kong, rapacious landlords try to evict 72 tenants but sworn brothers Ha Kugn and Shek Kin help the group of 72 defeat the landlord and landlady and coincidentally rescue Pinky from a planned forced marriage. When both sworn brothers fall for Pinky and propose to her, she flips a coin 'heads or tails' and Ha wins her hand in marriage. The sworn brothers become sworn enemies and Shek's hatred fuels intense rivalry against Ha in business dealings ranging from the manufacture of plastic flowers to the selling of stinky bean curd. Even after 40 years they continue to clash and in 2010 they are in keen competition selling electronics appliances in Sai Yeung Choi Street, Mongkok, the busiest street in the city and still home to the 72 tenants. In fiercely competitive Sai Yeung Choi Street high rents force businessmen to use every means to survive, with electronics shops.

credits.director: 鍾澍佳, 葉念琛, 曾志偉

programme.title: 瘦身男女
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes an fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -翻開年少日記
programme.desc: Successful film ‘Time Still Turns The Pages' not only won four awards for new director Nick Cheuk, but also surprised the team by receiving enormous response from the society. In this interview, Nick mentions his inspiration behind the story and talks with the film's leading actress Rosa Maria Velasco about unforgettable scenes especially the outstanding performance of young actor Sean Wong. Lastly, they have the hearts set on the film to encourage the audience to get better at expressing and channeling own feelings.

programme.title: 「兒戲」不兒戲: 年少日記
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng looks back to his repressed childhood memories, as he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. He strives hard to prevent another tragedy from happening, meanwhile facing a series of family problems, his wife is divorcing him, and his father is dying.

programme.title: 爆谷影之選 微電影「創+作」（音樂篇）
programme.desc: 'T.F.E.' is a micro-movie blending music, sci-fi, and comedy. Security guard Chak accidentally drinks an alien beverage called 'T.F.E.,' gaining superpowers and becoming a community hero-but also attracting extraterrestrial visitors and chaos. Through clashes and cooperation with strict supervisor Lam, he discovers his true purpose. With humor and absurdity, the film explores belonging, growth, and the power of music, ending on an imaginative and heartfelt note.

programme.title: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman..

programme.title: 紮職
programme.desc: William, Derek and Edward have worked for Patrick's gang in Yaumatei since they were 16. William is educated as well as courageous. After graduating from university, a former classmate referred him to a job as a debt collector for a wealthy businessman. He very quickly makes a lot of money and forms his own team. He and the businessman's daughter Michelle are very much in love. In his dealings, he offends Angry Ming. Later, in the name of gang business, and very much against Patrick's directives, William kills Angry Ming. He did this for two reasons: one, for revenge, and two, to lay the foundation for himself to become the head of the gang. But very unexpectedly, Angry Ming's widow Irene not only fights him for the position of Dragon Head, she also wants to avenge her husband, an eye for an eye. At the same time, Michelle wants William to run away to America with her, and leave gang business behind. In the end, will William be able to leave the gang completely.

programme.title: 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: 奪冠
programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes.

programme.title: 我知女人心
programme.desc: Sun is not exactly the ideal husband, father or son, but family takes the backseat against career. As the top brass of the leading ad agency, his mind is only fixed on being promoted to the executive creative director post. But the announcement comes and Sun is beaten by a new colleague Ly, renowned as the Iron Lady in the ad industry. The boss believes Ly would bring a competitive edge for the agency - the female perspective. Sun and Ly are at loggerheads at first sight, and she gives him an assignment - takes home a box of female hygiene products, and present an ad idea the next morning. That night, Sun is brainstorming in the bathtub when he accidentally drops a lamp in the water. The electric shock knocks him out, and when he wakes up in the hospital, he realizes he has a new gift - he can really hear what women think! By listening to the inner thoughts of the opposite sex, Sun quickly wins the hearts and trust of all women..

programme.title: 逆權司機
programme.desc: May 1980. A Seoul taxi driver named Man-seob comes across an offer too good to be true. If he drives a foreign passenger from Seoul down to Gwangju and back again before the curfew, he'll be paid the unthinkable sum of 100,000 won – enough to cover several months of unpaid rent. Without stopping to ask the details, he picks up the German reporter Peter and sets off along the highway. Although stopped by police roadblocks at the edge of Gwangju, Man-seob is desperate to earn his taxi fare, and eventually manages to find a way into the city. There they encounter students and ordinary citizens taking part in large-scale demonstrations against the government. Man-seob, alarmed by the danger in the air, pleads with Peter to go quickly back to Seoul. But Peter ignores him..

programme.title: 失蹤
programme.desc: In 2005, a high-profile case of a police officer who disappeared during a forest hike spawned urban legends about the existence of a gateway into another world. In 2016, those legends inspired popular internet novel Missing, which is now being adapted into an eerie supernatural thriller by first-time director and Fresh Wave alum Ronnie Chau. Former pop idol Gillian Chung stars as a social worker who hires a mountain guide to search for her missing father in the mountains. She discovers the mystical gateway from the urban legends, but is her father really waiting for her on the other side.

programme.title: 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: 長安三萬里
programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..

programme.title: 販賣．愛
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -踢出逆轉勝
programme.desc: The film “Pass and Goal”, collaborated by Gigi Leung, Peter Chan, Ling Man Lung and Rachel Leung, brings a blend of laughter, passion and inspiration. Gigi has burst out laughing when recalled funny scenes from the film. While Man Lung tells that he seemed like a scolded kid during a scene together with Gigi, Rachel also reveals a stunning reason of taking her role and Peter even names Gigi as a “new comedy star held up by romantic film”.

programme.title: 「兒戲」不兒戲: 非同凡響
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.

programme.title: 爆谷影之選 微電影「創+作」（音樂篇）
programme.desc: Memento Mori follows four young friends who know their exact time of death. In the final hours of their countdown, they gather for a farewell party that belongs only to them. With laughter, confessions, and fragile honesty, they hold one another close, trying to preserve a last fragment of courage before fear takes over.As death approaches them one by one, every reaction-friendship, regret, and the pretenses they once hid behind-is laid bare under the unforgiving light of the end.

programme.title: 無間道
programme.desc: This is a story between the mole in the police department, Ming(Andy Lau) and the undercover cop, Yan(Tony Leung), who are competing to uncover each other first..

programme.title: 東京復仇者
programme.desc: Takemichi Hanagaki leads a dead-end life in a run-down apartment while working part-time at a job for a younger manager who treats him like an idiot. Then one day, he learns that a girl he used to date during his hooligan days in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, and her brother, Naoto, have been murdered by the Kanto area's most villainous hoodlums, Tokyo Manji. The very next day, Takemichi is standing on a train platform when he is suddenly pushed onto the tracks. But instead of dying, Takemichi is transported ten years into the past where he is reunited with Hinata's younger brother, Naoto. “10 years from now, Hinata and you will be killed” he tells Naoto, thus altering the future. Hinata still doesn't survive, but Naoto does, becoming a police detective. Returning to the present day, Takemichi recruits Naoto's help in returning to the past to crush Tokyo Manji and save his Hinata's life once and for all. All Takemichi needs to do to travel through time is to shake hands w.

programme.title: 寄了一整個春天
programme.desc: Ching, a high school girl who wants to fall in love but feels isolated due to being born with a stutter, runs an online business with Rachel, her only friend. Ching unexpectedly gains the attention and love of buyers. As she submerges herself in this unethical business, Ching believes she has found true love. However, she is unaware that she has lost her only friendship.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 長津湖
programme.desc: The story takes place in winter, 1950. In the freezing cold Changjin Lake region, a bloody battle between the United States and China begins. Faced with the harshest conditions of extreme cold, lack of rations and vast difference in weaponry, the Chinese troops forge ahead, fearless and determined. They successfully blow up the Shuimen Bridge, making the most critical victory in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea.

credits.director: 徐克, 陳凱歌, 林超賢

programme.title: 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: 三人行
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -UFO命案大揭秘
programme.desc: Filmed in just eleven days, the low-budget production “Unidentified Murder” saw a massive burst of creativity from both the cast and crew; the actors' improvisations kept the set filled with laughter. In this Interview, the creative team is invited to share their production process and reveal the chaotic, unpredictable moments the crew experienced while filming up on the hill.

programme.title: 走佬驚驚團
programme.desc: Gang of friends who never thought to do any good things, get luck by winning lotto. They bring all money to casino with hope it will be increased but get a huge debt instead. They decide to rob a car without knowing that there is a dead body inside. Their mission turns into 2, escape from police as suspected murderers and they have to get away from owner of the casino.

programme.title: 真假佈局
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in the hotel where the two of them spent time together. Apart from Min-ho, there is no trace of anyone else having been there. Immediately singled out as the prime suspect, Min-ho maintains his innocence, and he hires the lawyer Shin-ae, who has a 100% record of victory in court, to defend him. In order to prove his innocence, she asks Min-ho to confess to her the entire truth. He admits that a car accident that they were in the day before the murder may be connected in some way to Se-hee's death.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 此情此刻
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.

programme.title: 夏日大作戰
programme.desc: Worlds collide in a tale where virtual reality meets actual reality. When Kenji Koiso is pulled from Oz, a popular social networking realm, to play fiance to classmate Natsuki, he faces a mess of challenges. Between the boisterous and bickering characters of the Jinnouchi clan and the sudden chaos in Oz, Kenji and his new companions must learn the importance of coming together to face the toughest of odds.

programme.title: 談判專家
programme.desc: Negotiator expert Cheuk Man Wai unexpectedly becomes the prime suspect in a murder case. Forced into a corner, he occupies the police station, taking officers hostage, and demands negotiations with the former negotiator Tse Ka Chun. With Tse's expertise in psychological manipulation and Cheuk's exceptional skills, they engage in a battle of wits. As the verbal sparring deepens, their positions and mindsets gradually change...This film is adapted from the American movie 'The Negotiator'.

programme.title: 「兒戲」不兒戲: 秘密之丘
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

programme.title: 爆谷影之選 微電影「創+作」（音樂篇）
programme.desc: Late at night, Heyson returns home, stirring memories of his distant relationship with his father, Kingman. The story weaves between past and present: a child longing for companionship, a father trapped in work and regret. When Heyson's sexuality is unexpectedly exposed, years of tension erupt. After running out, he discovers their old “treasure box,” revealing forgotten warmth. Through this rediscovered memory, father and son finally face each other and begin to heal.

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: 大搜查之女
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Molline Szeto is assigned to investigate the kidnap of a boy, whose father is the kingpin of illegal red oil in Greater China, John Fok.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 極速快遞
programme.desc: “I deliver everything that the post office service does not handle.” Eun-ha, who is a normal junkyard employee, secretly works as a delivery clerk that deals with unusual delivery request. One day, Eun-ha heads to Seoul to pick up a client who is involved in a gambling crime that wants to flee overseas. However, Eun-ha meets the client's young son at the pick-up point, instead of the client himself. Kyung-pil, a current police officer who is actually masterminding the whole gambling crime, chases after the missing child who has the security key to the bank account that holds 30 million dollars. After a long pursuit from Seoul to Busan, Eun-ha fights against the police to protect the child.

programme.title: 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: During the second battle of the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, the 9th Corps Command issues an order for the 7th Infantry Company to attack the Sumun Bridge. The 7th Company suffers a tough march to the Sumun Bridge. The soldiers are near their limits, every step forward in the midst of the harsh weather only means another great challenge to the body and mind..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 看我今天怎麼說
programme.desc: Wolf, born into a Deaf family, embraces sign language with confidence despite obstacles in life; Sophie, having a cochlear implant at a young age, continuously strives to be seen as 'normal', despite struggling with oral language. Alan, with a cochlear implant like Sophie, is capable of both oral and sign language; he advocates for diverse modes of communication within the deaf community. Bound by love and friendship, the three embark on a self-discovering journey with their own moments of pain.

programme.title: 扮工女團補英班
programme.desc: In mid ‘90s when sexual and academic discriminations were rampant, 3 young female office workers, Ja-young, Yu-nah, Bo-ram, are shunned by their company and are only given insignificant chores due to the fact that they only have high school diplomas. When a company-wide memo goes around announcing that obtaining 600 score in TOEIC could earn them a promotion, the trio and other high school grad female office workers enroll in English classes in hope of thought of finally advancing their careers. One day, Ja-young is sent to a factory in the country on an errand and by chance witnesses its waste water being poured into the river. She's convinced that the company is into shady dealings, and together with her 2 friends, they go on a hunt to find irrefutable evidence but they're on the verge of getting fired by the company trying to cover up the corruption. When the rumor of the trio's renegade action goes around, they are completely shunned by everyone there. But the female wor.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 小心陷井
programme.desc: Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.

programme.title: 假冒女團
programme.desc: Cercis Lui goes undercover in this lively comedy as an officer of the 'International Association for the Physical and Mental Health Development of Underage Boys and Girls” dedicated to protecting young boys and girls from being exploited in their pursuit of pop stardom. When tasked with taking down a shady talent show and its mastermind, Big Boss, Cercis must disguise himself as a woman to enter the competition. Only then can he get close enough to gather the evidence to take down the criminal ring. Joining this outlandish operation are Helianthus - an entertainment reporter, Circle O – a wannabe popstar, Lilium - a notorious artist and Oval O – cousin of Circle O from the US. But does this ragtag team have what it takes to triumph over the shady side of the business.

programme.title: 家有囍事2020
programme.desc: The Yau's brothers are a trio of scammers who make punishing baddies their mission. A misunderstanding leads them to fellow con artists the Lui's sisters, and they join hands to scam a notorious mob boss. Through a myriad of ingenious tricks and disguises, they bring the mobster to justice as romance blossoms swiftly..

programme.title: 未來的未來
programme.desc: The movie follows a 4-year old boy who is struggling to cope with the arrival of a little sister in the family, until things turn magical. A mysterious garden in the backyard of the boy's home becomes a gateway allowing the child to travel back in time and encounter his mother as a little girl and his great-grandfather as a young man. These fantasy-filled adventures allow the child to change his perspective and help him become the big brother he was meant to be.

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -UFO命案大揭秘
programme.desc: Filmed in just eleven days, the low-budget production “Unidentified Murder” saw a massive burst of creativity from both the cast and crew; the actors' improvisations kept the set filled with laughter. In this Interview, the creative team is invited to share their production process and reveal the chaotic, unpredictable moments the crew experienced while filming up on the hill.

programme.title: 「兒戲」不兒戲: 怪物
programme.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight..

programme.title: 點五步
programme.desc: In the year of 1984, the Sino-British Joint Declaration was signed, and the future of Hong Kong became unclear. In the stream of history, this story of a baseball team beneath the Lion Rock had gradually been forgotten. In that year, 'Shatin Martins', the first Hong Kong youth baseball team, was formed. The 10 young players were living an uneasy and restless life as Hong Kong was being humiliated by one defeat after another and the fate of the 'Shatin Martins'..

programme.title: 芳香之城傳奇
programme.desc: Princess Su of the magical Aroma City falls to earth and in love with Jiang. But as Jiang is no angel, there is an infernal contract out on his soul..

programme.title: 焚城的誕生
programme.desc: Directed by Anthony Pun, 'Cesium Fallout' is the first Hong Kong's historic first radiation disaster blockbuster that has won 5 nominations at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards. This documentary has recorded every little bits of behind-the-scene as well as the sharing from Anthony Pun, the cast and the production crew.

programme.title: 危樓深淵
programme.desc: An ordinary office worker Dong-won (KIM Sung-kyun) and his family move into a house he bought after years of saving. Overwhelmed with happiness, he invites his colleagues to a housewarming party, but heavy overnight rain leads to a gigantic sinkhole, and in a mere minute, it swallows up the entire apartment and the people inside. Hundreds of meters down the hole, Dong-won, his neighbor Man-su (CHA Seoung-won), and the unfortunate housewarming party guests must find their way out. Rain starts to pour down, filling the sinkhole with water, giving them very little time to get back to the surface.

programme.title: 只因我們天生一對：電影版
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.

credits.director: 維拉奇通吉拉, 努鄱法奈克柴威莫爾, 卡尼薩坤宇
credits.actor: Bright 瓦奇拉維特奇瓦雷
Win 梅塔文歐帕西安卡瓊

programme.title: 摘星廚神．巴黎夢
programme.desc: After their restaurant 'Grand Maison Tokyo' earned a Michelin three-star, Natsuki Obana and Rinko Hayami venture to Paris to open 'Grand Maison Paris,' aiming to become the first Asian chefs to achieve the same honor. However, they face cultural challenges and intense pressure in a city filled with culinary masters. Following a mishap at a gala dinner, Obana makes a pact with his former mentor: he will leave France if they don't earn three stars in the next Michelin evaluation. Can Obana and his team overcome these obstacles to achieve their dream.

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.

programme.title: 我的青春都是你
programme.desc: It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.

programme.title: 穿越時空的少女
programme.desc: Something strange has happened to Makoto Konno. Time has suddenly stopped and moved her backwards. With her newly discovered ability to literally leap backwards in time Makoto finds that tests become a piece of cake, embarrassing situations are corrected and she can have her favorite food anytime she wants. Unfortunately her carefree time traveling has adverse effects on the people she cares for. With every successful leap Makoto somehow alters the fate of those around her. This was not supposed to happen and as she races back in time to fix everything, she notices that her abilities are not limitless but with every successful jump she is one step closer to discovering the most wonderful secret in her young adult life.

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 片場職人 -霍佩詩
programme.desc: Ceci Fok, the art director of the film “Night King”, unveils how Hong Kong filmmakers create boundless imagination with limited resources, deeply deconstructing how to construct unique visual aesthetics in different film genres, the process of collecting props for the film, and how tedious work is transformed into endless fun, silently building passionate artistic dream brick by brick behind the scene.

programme.title: 「兒戲」不兒戲: 4拍4家族
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 獵狐行動
programme.desc: Dai Yichen, the Shanghai-based mastermind of a massive financial fraud who has been on the run for seven years, resurfaces in Paris, France. Chinese economic crime detective Ye Jun leads the 'Fox Hunt Team' on a cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets. The former swindler, who embezzled billions of yuan, has now ascended to the overseas high society, while the life savings of tens of thousands of people have been completely destroyed, leading to ruined families and countless tragedies. The flow of the illicit funds remains a mystery, with street chases, human bombs, and traps set by villains at every turn-each step is a struggle for survival! When the hunter becomes the hunted, can the Fox Hunt Team make a comeback against all odds? A hundred-million-yuan fraud, a cross-border manhunt.

programme.title: 燃冬
programme.desc: In cold wintry Yanji in northern China, visiting urbanite Haofeng feels lost and adrift. By chance, he meets Nana, a tour guide who instantly fascinates him. She introduces him to Xiao, a personable but frustrated restaurant worker. The trio bond quickly over a drunken weekend, fueled by a bit of lust. Confronting their individual traumas, their frozen desires slowly thaw as they seek to liberate themselves from an icy world.

programme.title: 手捲煙
programme.desc: Former Hong Kong Military Service Corps officer becomes caught in a triad manhunt when he takes in an ethnic South Asian man carrying a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live under the same roof, the two men transcend their cultural and racial differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: 熱帶往事
programme.desc: On a dark night, Xueming hits a pedestrian with his car and flees the scene. Desperate to escape his feelings of guilt, he decides to approach the dead man's wife, Mrs Liang. Meanwhile, the body is discovered - riddled with bullets. Chen, the detective in charge of the investigation, becomes obsessed with the case. Years later, all three remain caught in a tangled web of memories and lies, desperately searching for a truth that refuses to be revealed..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -掃毒之邱
programme.desc: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell not only has a grand lineup starring three Best Actors of the Hong Kong Film Awards, Sean Lau, Aaron Kwok and Louis Koo, but also includes spectacular action scenes. With the story background set in Thailand, the filming took place during the pandemic. Under such circumstance, what was Director Herman Yau's solution for scenes abroad? How did he maintain balance between safety and realness in the action scenes.

programme.title: 掃毒3: 人在天涯
programme.desc: Hong Kong police agent Cheung works undercover in Kang's drug cartel, while another undercover cop Au successfully earns their trust in an incident, a brotherly-bond is built among the three. After the Police busts the syndicate in Hong Kong, Kang subsequently hide away in the Golden Triangle, by chance he receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust..

programme.title: 來自雪國的遺書
programme.desc: In 1945, after the end of World War II, Hatao Yamamoto was imprisoned in a concentration camp in Sibera, Russia. Despite the harsh, despairing condition in the camp, Hatao Yamamoto kept telling other prisoners not to give up hope, and that the day when they could all go back home would come. Hatao Yamamoto firmly believed that he would return to Japan and meet his wife, Mojimi Yamamoto, and their children someday. 8 years after the war, he received a postcard from his wife with a one-line message written on it, stating that “We are waiting for you to come back”. Meanwhile, Hatao Yamamoto's health was deteriorating rapidly. After having a diagnosis, the doctor told him that he had only three months left... After listening to his friends' advices, he decided to write a will and left it to his friends to bring it to his family when they were released. However, the will was seen as a spying message by the officers in the concentration camp and was confiscated..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -韓戲入骨
programme.desc: Song Kang Ho, winner of the Best Actor Award at the Cannes Film Festival, as well as the leading actor of Cobweb, visited Hong Kong and was interviewed by Director Jack Ng. Cobweb tells a story about a movie set in Korea during the 1970s. In the movie, Song Kang Ho acted as Director Kim, who wouldn't care to stand against others in order to achieve perfection. In this episode, Song Kang Ho will share how he pondered his character in the movie, and what's his impression on Hong Kong movies.

programme.title: 韓戲逼人
programme.desc: After his successful debut, Director KIM endures scathing attacks from critics who call him a specialist in trashy dramas. After finishing his latest feature ‘Cobweb', he has vivid dreams over several days of an alternative ending to the film. Sensing that if he can just shoot those scenes as he envisioned them, a masterpiece will surely emerge, he tries to arrange just two days of additional shooting. However, the rewritten script fails to pass censorship, and his actors can't make sense of the new ending. Between the tangled schedule, the opposition of the producer, and the collision between these fantastic scenes dancing before his eyes and the harsh conditions of reality, Director KIM feels he is about to go insane, but he pushes on regardless..

programme.title: 刺心切骨
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 香港四徑大步走
programme.desc: At the time, they said it couldn't be done. In 2012, Andre Blumberg set off by himself, to run all four of Hong Kong's iconic ultra distance trails in just four days. 298km and over 14,500m of climbing later, one of the hardest ultra marathons in the world - the Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge - was born. With the 2021 edition of the challenge as the backdrop, 'Four Trails' takes you on a journey from when the concept was first was conceived to it's current format. Under 60 hours to be deemed a 'Finisher' and under 72 hours to be a ‘Survivor', unsupported and with an ever evolving set of rules. It takes a deep dive into the famous four trails that make up the challenge and you will both laugh and cry as the astonishing stories of those who dare attempt such a feat unfold.

programme.title: 怪物之子
programme.desc: When Kyuta, a young orphan living on the streets of Shibuya, stumbles into a fantastic world of beasts, he's taken in by Kumatetsu, a gruff, rough-around-the-edges warrior beast who's been searching for the perfect apprentice. Despite their constant bickering, Kyuta and Kumatetsu begin training together and slowly form a bond as surrogate father and son. But when a deep darkness threatens to throw the human and beast worlds into chaos, the strong bond between this unlikely pair will be put to the ultimate test-a final showdown that will only be won if the two can finally work together using all of their combined strength and courage.

programme.title: 他年她日
programme.desc: Measure in Love is set in the universe where a massive earthquake has divided the world into Aurora Zone and Evergreen Zone, and the “Wall of Gravity” standing in the middle of the sea distorts time and gravity differently on both sides. One day in Aurora Zone equals one year in Evergreen Zone. When Ann-Jean from the Aurora Zone meets Tato from the Evergreen Zone, can their love break through the irresistible fate of time differences.

programme.title: 「兒戲」不兒戲: 激戰
programme.desc: After a stint in prison for participating in underground boxing, Fai is knee-deep in debt with no solution in sight. To escape his debtors, he flees to Macau and works as a gym assistant. He meets and ends up training Si-Qi, a hot-blooded young man who enrolled in an open MMA competition with no fighting experience. After a series of wins, Si-Qi is critically injured and eliminated from the tournament. Ignited by Si-Qi's persistence and unwillingness to give up in the face of defeat, he rediscovers his will to fight and steps back in the ring against the fighter who injured his student..

programme.title: 原罪犯
programme.desc: One night in 1988, ordinary-man OH Dae-su, who lives with his wife and an adorable baby daughter, is kidnapped. He later wakes up to find himself in a private makeshift prison. While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. As the team approaches the truth, another shocking-secret is revealing...

programme.title: 長夜盡頭的微光
programme.desc: After a series of mishaps at work caused by her severe pre-menstrual syndrome, Fujisawa lands a new job at an astronomical toy factory, where she meets Yamazoe, a tacit colleague plagued by panic attacks. There the two, whose careers have been derailed by their respective conditions, learn to support and care for each other through life's ups and downs despite their initial friction.

programme.title: 凶靈祭
programme.desc: A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be. A documentary team follows Nim, a shaman based in Northern Thai, the Isan area, and encounters her niece Mink showing strange symptoms that seem to be of inheritance of shamanism. The team decides to follow Mink, hoping to capture the shaman lineage passing on to the next generation, but her bizarre behavior becomes more extreme.

programme.title: 海的盡頭是草原
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, Du Siheng was sent to Shanghai Orphanage by her mother, who couldn't support two kids. Later, she was transferred to Inner Mongolia and adopted by a loving family. Sixty years later, Du Sihan set out for Inner Mongolia and embarked on a journey to find his elder sister. The journey, however, turned out to be full of twists and turns...... Du Siheng couldn't adapt to the life on the grassland when she first arrived in Inner Mongolia. Touched by the love and warmth from the Mongolia people, the young Du Siheng gradually integrated into her new family. After six decades, the sister and brother reunited again and finally let go of the past. They reminisced the days when their fathers fought for the land beneath their feet and drew motivation from the older generation to work hard for a more promising and prosperous future.

programme.title: 第一刑事部的烏鴉
programme.desc: Two years have passed since Michio Irima left first criminal court (commonly known as “Ichikei”). Michio is transferred to Setouchi in Okayama Prefecture, where he is assigned to an assault case involving the youngest Minister of Defense in history. His investigations lead him to look into a collision incident involving an Aegis warship, but the details of the ships voyage are a national secret. Michio is now faced with an adversary upon which the threat of “official authority” does not work. Meanwhile, Chizuru Sakama, who has tried numerous cases with Michio, is working as a lawyer in a neighboring town under a work experience program. There, she takes on a case involving a large local company which supports the whole town, but not all is as it seems...Between these seemingly disparate cases, a shocking truth arises. Are they opening a Pandora's Box that was best left alone?

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for.

programme.title: 我在時間盡頭等你
programme.desc: Some lives are linked across time, connected by destiny. While aiding an old theatre attendant Lin Ge (Lee Hongchi), aspiring dancer Qiu Qian (Li Yitong) stumbles upon his diary which chronicles the life and memories they shared together since childhood, thus discovering a timeless love story concealed in another dimension.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：廖子妤: 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit.

programme.title: 總理之夫
programme.desc: Ornithologist (a scholar of birds) Hiyori Soma is married to Rinko, leader of a minority political party. One morning, his beloved wife poses an enigmatic question. “Hey, Hiyori, would you have a problem if I became Prime Minister?” He asks her to repeat the question, but she shrugs him off. Still confused, he sets off for a ten-day expedition on a remote island with no cell phone connection to observe birds in the wild. In his absence, Rinko changes the future of the nation! She is elected the first female Prime Minister in Japan's history, making Hiyori the first ever Prime Minister's husband. He was always 100% supportive of Rinko's political ambitions, but could never have imagined the life that awaited him..

programme.title: 總是有愛在隔離
programme.desc: On a quiet and peaceful afternoon, the Hong Kong Grande Hotel suddenly becomes the center of attention when it is suspected to be the epicenter of the coronavirus outbreak. The Center for Disease Control orders the hotel to be sealed, forcing its guests to undergo a mandatory 14-day quarantine. However, being isolated from the world ends up bringing the quarantined people together in unexpected ways. As they bond over this difficult time, they learn to treasure what may be their final moments together.

programme.title: 殺出個黃昏
programme.desc: Last generation of assassins moved to HK in 50/60's and posted as “killer-for-hire' trio to fix all sort of problems for their clients. Decades passed, they now become redundant themselves at work and home. An accidental mission calls upon them turns out to be an assisted suicide. The trio suddenly finds new ‘life'.....as ”Guardian Angels of the Elders”. Just when they are finding meanings to this new role, an order from a teenager turns their new practice upside down again......this might as well be their very last job.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：「兒戲」不兒戲: 逆轉上半場
programme.desc: If life were a football match, her first half was definitely a victory.After losing her fortune in a botched crypto scheme, Hay Man reluctantly moves in with her cousin's family. She pleads with her former subordinate Joe to stage a comeback by introducing her to a wealthy heir, Alex, who seeks to prove himself to his father by organizing a football match. Seeing Alex as a financial opportunity, Hay Man recruits her cousin Ying and several underprivileged children-Alam, OK, Fat B and Lun to form a team, enlisting former football star Siu Ho as their coach. As she trains the children in fitness and teamwork, they gradually build a sincere bond. Inspired by the children's resilience, Hay Man seeks to redeem the second half of her life by rewriting the narrative for children in need of support and hope.

programme.title: 我要做接班人 -蔡蕙琪
programme.desc: A character with unique accent unexpectedly made this previously unknown actress an overnight sensation! In this episode, Kay Choi, who played Francesca in the film “Night King,” is invited to talk about how she seized the audition opportunity, added flair to the character with her creativity, and share her inner struggles of portraying a club girl on screen. As she approaches thirty and her career begins to take off, how will she face the society's definition toward women at her age, and what are her expectations for the future.

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 三人世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..

programme.title: 扭計雜牌軍
programme.desc: Four sworn brothers failed heist and get into jail for years. Sheng is set free. The three ask Sheng to get the hidden loot and wait for their eventual reunion. Sheng discovers the loot has disappeared but the other three are convinced Sheng has stolen it. Sheng has to escape. His childhood lover Chuan tries to help him to go overseas but is hurt when Sheng falls for insurance detective Bonnie. Sheng and Bonnie buy tickets from Liang who is left holding the bag when his boss absconds with the money..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔大顯神通
programme.desc: King Kong was attacked by the robot - Black Knight I which was sent by the Italian Mafia to avenge the capture of White Gloves. He also hired an internationally notorious killer Black Gloves to kill King Kong as well as diamond transfer deal with the underworld. King Kong join forces with the police to capture Black Gloves who sends Black Knight II to attack..

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..

programme.title: 葉童．傲骨芳華: 等待黎明
programme.desc: The story is set against the backdrop of Hong Kong in 1941. Fai, a young man who's trying to scrape up enough money to catch a boat to the U.S. He befriends Kong, who comes from a wealthy family but now works as a coolie working for a successful rice merchant. Kong's childhood friend, Anna who is betrothed to a man by her politically ambitions father. The trio decides to make a run for the boat but on the day of their planned escape, the war breaks out and they are forced to stay behind. Fai signs up to work for the enemy to help Kong and Anna in their next attempt to escape..

programme.title: 賭俠大戰拉斯維加斯
programme.desc: The story to after The Conman, where Dragon's sister Ching went to study in Canada. After King and Dragon defeated Macau Mon, they became swindling partners..

programme.title: Office有鬼
programme.desc: In every lunar July, there would be nine persons died in this building and no one knows the reason. Ken came to this building for interview. He saw several ladies talking about ghost story in the lobby. Amongst the ladies, he found his old girlfriend, Pat and another attractive girl who was wearing a red dress..

programme.title: 阿金
programme.desc: Ah Kam is from Mainland China and is trained in kung fu. She becomes a double in Hong Kong. Tung and his partners of the Tung's Family, a stunt man group, cannot work as stuntmen after an ambush. Tung lets Kam try being the stunt director and Kam becomes very popular. Kam married Sam and moves to Shenzhen to look after Sam's karaoke business. However, being a karaoke manager does not suit Kam. At the same time, Sam is unfaithful and so Kam returns to the movie industry and once again becomes a stuntwoman..

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 新仙鶴神針
programme.desc: While the world of martial arts is in probably the most peaceful period for a long while, the Tien Lung Tribe suddenly emerges with a strong military presence as if it were to conquer the warring society. As its presence begin to stir up everyone in the scene, the Court decides to order the leader of the Six Fan Gates – Cho Hung to gather the ten most esteemed tribes for a conference in an attempt to prevent any chaos or unnecessary warfare in the community..

programme.title: 逆天者
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed..

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 影人映語 -鐵骨闖江湖 - 錢小豪
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode.

programme.title: 發達先生
programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed..

programme.title: 最佳福星
programme.desc: The lucky stars reunite again. Having the new members joined in, they are playful and frolicsome as usual. This time, their mission is to investigate a case of international ammunition trade that involves two gangs. One is the Japanese underworld society that holds many stolen diamonds, and another one is the mysterious terrorists who own an enormous amount of ammunition. Let's see how the lucky stars overcome the danger and problem.

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲：葉童．傲骨芳華: 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends..

programme.title: 原振俠與衛斯理
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies..

programme.title: 衛斯理之老貓
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely..

programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely..

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

programme.title: 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence..

programme.title: 鬼馬校園
programme.desc: A new school term begins. Vivacious high school girl Jane hurries back to Hong Kong from overseas, where she spent her vacation. Chinese-American college student Wan Ho follows her all the way to Hong Kong to get close to her. But Jane is so popular in school and is used to having boys around her. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Meanwhile, Pak Yat Moon has a crush on Wan Ho, and Ka Ming has crush on Pak Yat Moon! It is a total mess and the relationships become utterly chaotic! Everything culminates in a showdown during a big basketball game..

programme.title: 油尖少爺
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 賊王
programme.desc: Wisdom thief Yam Ka Wa having girlfriend Ann as an inside accomplice, using high-tech techniques robbed the escort vehicle and stole one hundred and seventy million dollars. Crime Unit Chief Inspector Lee and his detectives working around the clock to detect, eventually discovered clues. They suspect that Wa and Ann were the mastermind of the case, but there was no evidence against them. Lee tried various methods of interrogation to no avail, finally has to resort to torture, but the two remain resolute, enduring the torture and recriminate Lee for police brutality..

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation..

programme.desc: The movie bases itself on the life of 'Naam Hoi Sap Saam Long' who was a gifted, famed and productive playwright in the 1930s.
